Static searches found no implementation references to the triggering fixture, checker labels, mechanism perturbation path, golden file reads, include_str/include_bytes of test diagrams, coordinate-keyed SVG surgery, the observed half-fraction offsets, or new high-precision compensating constants in the touched production paths.

Five fresh held-outs pass strict no-oracle comparison: note-dominant fractional width, label-dominant fractional width, note-only vertical fractional width, label-only control, and default-direction reversed multiline note composition.

One fresh held-out fails: checker_03_reversed_multiline_fractional combines explicit left-to-right direction, a reversed edge, and a multiline note. The failure is a consistent 0.2422px vertical drift across nodes, edge, ordinary label, and note rows. The default-direction reversed multiline companion passes, so this looks like broader left-to-right SVEK envelope/bias residue rather than proof that the preferred-dimensions split is wrong.

Acceptance should wait until the left-to-right counterexample either passes or is explicitly scoped into a separate signed-off target/account.
